title: 第五章 风雷双翅百年结算第六章 剑仙当有剑剑来
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
风雷仙杏入喉，便化作风、雷两道先天本源在李玄霄体内轰然炸开。
雷源霸道，风源亦猛，瞬间便席卷了李玄霄四肢百骸。
毫无意外，若是此前他本身的凡俗根骨在这股先天之力下定会如同纸糊般经脉寸寸撕裂，微薄仙元也会在转瞬被狂暴的风雷冲得七零八落，连元神都要被震得发颤。
但现在不一样了。
李玄霄已然炼化了那开天第一道剑气，肉身神魂都得了极大提升，两股暴躁的风雷之力，虽在暴走，可并未突破李玄霄所能承受的上限。
“凝神守一！抱元固窍！”
多宝道人低喝一声，指尖弹出数道玄黄禁制，如同锁链般锁住四处乱窜的风雷之力，将其牢牢框定在李玄霄经脉之内。
他本已做好大费周章帮李玄霄重塑道基的准备，可下一刻，眉头便微不可察地一挑。
只因为多宝感应到了李玄霄体内那一道锐利至极的锋芒！
多宝眼底闪过一丝讶异，却没有多问，手上力道不减，玄黄之气缓缓引导着风雷之力流转周天，助他洗髓伐脉炼化风雷！
李玄霄心无旁骛，全部心神沉浸在炼化之中。
不过才小半日功夫，多宝道人便停了下来。
李玄霄缓缓睁眼，意念微动，周身风雷大震，背后那风雷双翅猛地展开！
整个偏殿之中转瞬便充满了狂暴的风雷之力。
成了！
且李玄霄不仅炼化了风雷之力，其修为亦是在这小半日内，突破到了地仙后期。
等回了洞府，再好好修炼一番，定还能有所精进！
李玄霄收了神通，起身对着多宝道人深深一揖：“多谢大师兄出手相助，此恩，李玄霄铭记于心！”
多宝道人抬手虚扶，笑道：“玄霄师弟，你却是比金鳌岛九成九的弟子都能藏拙。”
李玄霄心中一凛，心知怕是刚刚多宝帮助自己压制风雷之力，感知到了那开天第一条先天剑气。

不过多宝乃是自己的大师兄，李玄霄倒也不慌不忙，只躬身恭敬道：“大师兄明鉴，弟子并非有意欺瞒。只是洪荒凶险，量劫当头，我这点微末机缘与修为，露出来只会惹来杀身之祸，不如藏拙苟全，以求安身立命。”
这话半分虚言没有，只是大实话。
多宝道人闻言非但没有不悦，反倒朗声笑了起来：“好！好一个藏锋苟全！截教万仙、洪荒生灵，多的是有了点本事就目空一切的狂士，却少有人懂‘藏锋’二字。你能有这份心性，倒也难得。”
“你本是记名弟子，如今也只是地仙修为，别说碧游宫听道只能挤在最外围，便是金鳌岛藏经阁、丹房，你都踏不进去。”
多宝随手一挥，一枚青色玉牌落在李玄霄手中。
“有此令牌，你可进藏经阁前三层借阅功法典籍，每年也可去丹房领一份修炼资源。”
李玄霄瞳孔微缩，心中大喜过望。
“多谢大师兄！”
李玄霄再次郑重行礼，这份人情，他牢牢记在了心里。
“不必这般。”
多宝摆了摆手：“我截教有教无类，望你日后也心归截教、能守得住本心，眼下巫妖决战就要到来，你且安心修炼，莫要沾了不该沾的因果。”
“师弟谨记大师兄教诲！绝不忘了本心！”
李玄霄忙应下。
“去吧，三霄、石矶师妹还在外面。”
多宝挥了挥手，不再多言。
content_en:
When the Wind and Thunder Immortal Apricot entered his throat, it turned into the two innate sources of wind and thunder and exploded in Li Xuanxiao's body.
The thunder source was domineering, and the wind source was also fierce, and it swept away Li Xuanxiao's limbs and bones in an instant.
It is no surprise that if his mortal bones had been exposed to this innate power before, his meridians would have been torn apart like paper, and his meager immortal energy would have been shattered to pieces by the violent wind and thunder in an instant, and even his soul would have been shaken to the point of trembling.
But it's different now.
Li Xuanxiao has already refined the first sword energy in the sky, and his physical body and soul have been greatly improved. Although the two violent wind and thunder forces are going berserk, they have not exceeded the upper limit of what Li Xuanxiao can withstand.
"Concentrate and guard one! Hold the essence and solidify the aperture!"
Taoist Duobao shouted low, and several black and yellow restraints popped out from his fingertips, locking the power of wind and thunder that was running around like chains, and firmly framed them within Li Xuanxiao's meridians.
He was already prepared to spend a lot of time to help Li Xuanxiao reshape his Taoist foundation, but the next moment, his brows raised imperceptibly.
Just because Duobao sensed the extremely sharp edge in Li Xuanxiao's body!
A trace of surprise flashed in Duobao's eyes, but he didn't ask any more questions. The strength in his hands did not decrease, and the black and yellow energy slowly guided the power of wind and thunder to flow around the sky, helping him cleanse his marrow, cut his veins, and refine the wind and thunder!
Li Xuanxiao had no distractions and was completely immersed in refining.
After only half a day's work, Taoist Duobao stopped.
Li Xuanxiao slowly opened his eyes, his thoughts moved slightly, and the wind and thunder shook around him, and the wind and thunder wings behind him spread out violently!
The entire side hall was filled with violent wind and thunder power in an instant.
Done!
Moreover, Li Xuanxiao not only refined the power of wind and thunder, but also broke through to the late Earth Immortal stage in just half a day.
When I return to the cave, if I practice hard, I will definitely be able to improve!
Li Xuanxiao withdrew his magical power, stood up and bowed deeply to Taoist Duobao: "Thank you so much, senior brother, for helping me. Li Xuanxiao will remember this kindness in my heart!"
Taoist Duobao raised his hand to support him and said with a smile: "Junior Brother Xuanxiao, you are better at hiding your clumsiness than 99% of the disciples on Jin'ao Island."
Li Xuanxiao's heart trembled, knowing that it was Duobao who had just helped him suppress the power of wind and thunder and sensed the first innate sword energy in the world.
However, Duobao was his senior brother, so Li Xuanxiao was not in a hurry, and just bowed and said respectfully: "Senior brother, I understand that this disciple has no intention to deceive. It's just that the wilderness is dangerous, and disaster is at hand. If my little chance and cultivation are revealed, it will only lead to death. It's better to hide my weakness and stay safe, in order to live a safe life."
There is no lie in this statement, it is just the truth.
Taoist Duobao, instead of being displeased when he heard this, laughed loudly: "Good! What a hidden front Gouquan! He teaches thousands of immortals and creatures in the wild, and most of them are madmen who are arrogant even if they have some ability, but few people understand the word 'hidden front'. It is rare for you to have this kind of character."
"You were originally a registered disciple, but now you are only an Earth Immortal. Not to mention that you can only squeeze into the outermost part of the Biyou Palace to listen to the teachings. Even the Jin'ao Island Sutra Pavilion and the Alchemy Room cannot be entered."
Duobao waved his hand casually, and a green jade token fell into Li Xuanxiao's hand.
"With this token, you can go to the first three floors of the Sutra Pavilion to borrow Kung Fu books, and you can also go to the alchemy room to receive a training resource every year."
Li Xuanxiao's pupils shrank slightly, and he was overjoyed.
"Thank you, senior brother!"
Li Xuanxiao saluted solemnly again, and he kept this favor firmly in his heart.
"It doesn't have to be like this."
Duobao waved his hand: "I, Jie Jiao, teach without distinction. I hope you will also return to Jie Jiao in the future and be able to keep your heart. Now that the decisive battle between the lich and the lich is coming, you can practice with peace of mind and don't get involved in any karma that you shouldn't have."
"Junior brother, remember the teachings of senior brother! Never forget your true heart!"
Li Xuanxiao hurriedly responded.
"Go, Junior Sister Sanxiao and Shiji are still outside."
Duobao waved his hand and said no more.
